spells.name: Misdirection (At Will; Self Only)
spells.text: You reshape the magic aura of one creature or object to resemble that of another. You designate one target as the primary target and the other as the secondary target. Effects that would detect auras on the primary target instead detect the same types of auras from the secondary target. A creature reading the aura can attempt to disbelieve the illusion. You can Dismiss the spell from up to a mile away.

items.name: Drained
items.text:
When a creature successfully drains you of blood or life force, you become less healthy. Drained always includes a value. You take a status penalty equal to your drained value on Constitution-based checks, such as Fortitude saves. You also lose a number of Hit Points equal to your level (minimum 1) times the drained value, and your maximum Hit Points are reduced by the same amount. For example, if you're hit by an effect that inflicts drained 3 and you're a 3rd-level character, you lose 9 Hit Points and reduce your maximum Hit Points by 9. Losing these Hit Points doesn't count as taking damage.

Each time you get a full night's rest, your drained value decreases by 1. This increases your maximum Hit Points, but you don't immediately recover the lost Hit Points.

items.name: Hatred of Red
items.text: Pairakas hate the color red. They won't wear the color or willingly enter any place painted red. Given a choice, they'll attack a creature wearing red first. If barred from expressing their displeasure toward the color by force or some magical effect, they take 2d6 mental damage at the end of their turn.

items.name: Bubonic Plague
items.text:
A creature can't remove the Fatigued condition while infected

Saving Throw DC 23 Fortitude save

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 fatigued (1 day)

Stage 2 Enfeebled 2 and fatigued (1 day)

Stage 3 Enfeebled 3, fatigued, and take 1d6 bleed damage every 1d20 minutes (1 day)

items.name: Change Shape
items.text: Yshula can take the appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid or animal. This doesn't change his Speed or his attack and damage modifiers with the Strikes, but it might change the damage type his strikes deal.

items.name: Cottage-Drained
items.text: Yshula is Drained 2 and can't recover from his drained condition while he's in the cottage. These reductions are included in his statistics.

items.name: Tormenting Dreams
items.text:
Frequency once per day

---

Effect Yshula torments a sleeping creature within 100 feet with visions of betrayals by loved ones and friends. The target must attempt a DC 25 Will save save, with the effects of the Nightmare spell.
